description: This file defines data structures and functions related to configuration schema processing, including handling of schema nodes, UI hints, and path matching. It appears to be part of a configuration management or validation component within a larger application.

classes.name: ConfigUiHint
classes.description: Represents UI hints for configuration fields, including label, help text, order, and sensitivity.

classes.name: ConfigSchemaNode
classes.description: Represents a node in a configuration schema, capable of providing metadata like title, description, types, properties, and navigation through schema paths.

methods.name: decodeUiHints
methods.description: Decodes a dictionary of raw UI hints into a structured form keyed by path keys.

methods.name: hintForPath
methods.description: Retrieves the most relevant UI hint for a specific configuration path, supporting wildcards.

methods.name: isSensitivePath
methods.description: Determines if a configuration path refers to sensitive information such as tokens or passwords.

methods.name: pathKey
methods.description: Constructs a string key from a configuration path by concatenating key segments.
